comment.body:
Thanks for the details already provided: the report says PowerToys 0.53.3, a large image, and that reverting to a pre-PowerToys version appeared to restore resizing. Because the thread is old and does not identify the image format or a current failing build, we cannot tell whether this still reproduces or which input path fails.

Please:
1. Confirm whether right-click > Resize still fails on a current PowerToys release and include the exact version.
2. If it still reproduces, attach one non-sensitive failing image (or give its format and dimensions if you cannot share it), and state which resize options were selected and whether an output file was created.
